theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_ccm_coset_crt_equivariant
theorems.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ) [NeZero m] [NeZero n], Nat.Coprime m n → let G := Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ; let Q := fun k : ℕ => G ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 k; ∃ e : Q (m * n) ≃ (Q m × Q n), ∀ (g : G) (q : Q (m * n)), e (g • q) = g • e q
